tools.name: lessons_select
tools.description: Select at most 6 relevant lessons from the personal-wiki lesson ledger for one repository, bounded to 600 UTF-8 bytes of lesson text and one 4096-byte JSON result. Read-only: runs scripts/lessons.py select with a 4 s timeout, a minimal environment and no shell, and returns ok, empty, unavailable or a bounded error.

tools.name: lessons_staged
tools.description: Read the corrections staged for the lesson ledger, bounded to 4096 bytes of JSON. Read-only: it never writes, never runs a command and never promotes a lesson. Default returns counts plus up to 20 entries, newest first; format add-argv with an id returns the exact owner-runnable scripts/lessons.py add command line as text. Returns ok, empty, unavailable or a bounded error.
